newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds closed firmer, with markets waiting to see the features of a new Swiss federal bond which will be launched next week.
The bond will be announced on Tuesday and final terms set on Thursday.

Business was brisk. "We had quite good turnover, I think people are starting to guess about next week," said one trader. He added that speculation the Swiss franc will extend this week's gains could also bolster the Swiss bond market.
Traders were guessing as to the offering next week, with some saying it could contain a few surprises.
"Everyone expects the (outstanding) 4-1/2 percent 2007 to be reopened. But it could be something else, something exotic," said one trader.

A second trader said market participants were beginning to believe that the 4-1/2 June 2007 may be passed over next week in favour of reopening the outstanding 4-1/4 percent January 2008 bond. Or else it could be something entirely different.
"The 4-1/2 percent 2007 is already the second-largest outstanding issue. Maybe they will reopen the 4-1/8 2008 or maybe do something else, like a 12-year 4.00 percent offering," the trader said.
June Conf futures CONFM7 up 28 at 117.88.
June Comi medium-term bond COMIM7 up 25 at 111.15
June Euro Swiss francs FESM7 down one at 98.11.
